recognize_zh: CD10 免疫染色下，成片的大型腫瘤細胞呈細胞膜與細胞質陽性，核呈泡狀並有明顯核仁，細胞間有淡藍色纖維血管間隔；大細胞 CD10 陽性代表生發中心來源，符合濾泡性淋巴瘤 3B 級的大細胞群。
features: Sheets of large cells with membranous and granular cytoplasmic CD10 staining
Large round to oval vesicular nuclei with single conspicuous nucleoli
Moderate amount of pale cytoplasm outlined by the stain
Thin CD10-negative fibrovascular septa traversing the field
Staining intensity is moderate and somewhat heterogeneous
describe_en: CD10 immunohistochemical stain shows sheets of large neoplastic cells with moderate membranous and granular cytoplasmic positivity. The cells have large vesicular nuclei with conspicuous nucleoli and a moderate rim of pale cytoplasm, and are separated by thin CD10-negative fibrovascular septa. CD10 expression indicates a germinal center B-cell phenotype; in the context of a follicular growth pattern composed of solid sheets of centroblasts, findings are consistent with follicular lymphoma, grade 3B.

ddx.dx: Diffuse large B-cell lymphoma, GCB type
ddx.vs: DLBCL shows the same CD10+ large cells but lacks a residual CD21/CD23-positive follicular dendritic cell meshwork.
Burkitt cells are medium-sized with multiple small nucleoli, a starry-sky pattern, BCL2 negativity and ~100% Ki-67.
Pleomorphic MCL is CD10-negative, CD5-positive and cyclin D1/SOX11-positive.
Grade 3A still contains admixed centrocytes, whereas grade 3B follicles consist of solid sheets of centroblasts; CD10 may be lost in 3B.
